notes.heading: Sojourn Drive, 1.76 acres (Dallas Gymnastics Center)
items: Shared entrances are required at both the east and west property lines, with non-exclusive ingress-egress easements to adjacent properties.
All mechanical equipment on the building must be screened by an architecturally compatible screen or a parapet wall.

notes.heading: Sojourn Drive, 8.128 acres (about 870 ft east of Westgrove Drive)
items: On-site detention storage for stormwater runoff is required as part of an overall master drainage plan, with the detention pond on Lot 1.
An additional 4 ft of right-of-way along Westgrove Drive must be dedicated, and 5 ft sidewalks are required along all public streets.
Master water and sanitary sewer plans are required, and driveway entrances on Sojourn Drive must be high enough to avoid ponding from the street.
The site must have two points of access to the adjacent undeveloped property, and any utility easement to be abandoned needs a relocation plan.

notes.heading: Airborne Drive, 1.067 acres
items: At building permit, the applicant must submit a landscape plan showing the percentage of the site that is landscaped, stamped by a landscape architect licensed in Texas, and an irrigation plan.

notes.heading: 16800 Westgrove, 1.236 acres
items: An FAA Determination of No Hazard is required before the certificate of occupancy.
The owner must grant the Town an avigation easement before the building permit.
An acoustical expert must certify a 30 dB noise level reduction before the building permit and again before the certificate of occupancy.

notes.heading: 4201 Airborn Drive (Best Press)
items: The approved plans add a 42,655 sq ft warehouse addition to the existing building.
